name: user
label: User Information Table
description: The user information table is used for filtering enabled states related to the framework, time dimension statistics, and association queries for report scenarios.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: uuid
fields.description: Global unique identifier, cross-environment import use, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: User ID. This value must be unique in the database and is suitable for exact-match queries and duplicate detection.

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: token
fields.description: Randomly generated token for HMAC authentication. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the UUID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: email
indexes.description: Standard index covering the email field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the ID field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: token
indexes.description: Standard index covering the token field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: user_id_idx
indexes.description: Unique index covering the user_id field, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
